description: This file defines the 'Question' class in the Goteo project, representing a questionnaire question with methods to retrieve, save, validate, and manage question data, including database interactions and related external classes.

classes.name: Question
classes.description: Represents a questionnaire question with properties, retrieval, persistence, and validation methods within the Goteo system.

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Returns predefined question types such as 'textarea', 'boolean', and 'dropfiles', with their localized labels.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields that support multiple languages, here just 'title'.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a Question object by its ID from the database, decoding its 'vars' JSON field.

methods.name: getByQuestionnaire
methods.description: Retrieves all questions associated with a specific questionnaire ID, decoding their 'vars' JSON fields.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the question to the database, encoding 'vars' as JSON before persistence.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches a list of questions based on filters, supports pagination and count queries.

methods.name: getChoices
methods.description: Fetches associated options for the question using QuestionOptions class.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Placeholder method for validating question data, always returns true.
